title: Minswap Aiken Stableswap Audit + Bug Bounty

ms.promise:
・Stableswap code built on Aiken will undergo an audit by TxPipe, the company that built the Aiken programming language. 
・Educational campaign in collaboration with Cardano Spot (https://cardanospot.io/landing) to prepare the Cardano community and give them the educational resources needed to understand and later use the Stableswap.
・This Educational campaign will include: 
・A) 2 detailed articles about Stableswaps and Stablecoins and their importance for a mature DeFi ecosystem.
・B) Twitter threads such as the State of Stablecoins on Cardano.
・C) a Twitter Spaces on Stableswaps and Stablecoins to answer questions from the community.
ms.criteria:
・The Audit Report will only be released once the auditor TxPipe has also assessed the fixes implemented based on their Audit recommendations (which is the next Milestone). To ensure that the audit is undergoing, both Minswap Labs and TxPipe will announce the audit engagement on social media. The Audit Report will be released the month after (next Milestone).
・For the Education Campaign:
・A) At least one educational article about Stableswaps and Stablecoins delivered, published on the Minswap Medium and seen by the community.
・B) At least one educational article about Stableswaps and Stablecoin
ms.report:
・The article announcing audit commencement by TxPipe of the Minswap Stableswap
・The educational article about Stableswaps and Stablecoins on Cardano on the Minswap Medium
・A 2nd educational article by Cardano Spot focusing exclusively on Cardano Stablecoins
・A thread written in collaboration with Cardano Spot about State of Stablecoins on Cardano
・A second thread by Cardano Spot
・The Twitter Spaces discussing the recent developments on Stablecoins in Cardano co-hosted by Minswap Labs and Cardano Spot and with Mehen and Indigo Labs as guests.

ms.promise:
・Once the audit is complete, the process to address audit findings will start and finish within that same month. 
・Efforts will start to integrate the Stableswap Smart contract into the current UI.
ms.criteria:
・An Audit Report that provides a comprehensive audit of the Stableswap code and highlights vulnerabilities found. The Report should also corroborate the fixing of the audit findings addressed during this month.
・Screenshots of progress of integrating the Stableswap into the current UI.
ms.report:
・Link to the Audit Report by TxPipe
・Screenshot 1, Screenshot 2, Screenshot 3, Screenshot 4, Screenshot 5, Screenshot 6 on how the Stableswap will be integrated into the current UI.
